It provides equivalent security category 3 with classical-safe and post-quantum security based on the hardness of the Module Learning With Errors (MLWE) problem.

A hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 construction is recommended for migration. The hybrid combines a classical key exchange (for backward compatibility with non-PQC endpoints) with ML-KEM (for post-quantum security). This ensures that the final shared secret is secure as long as at least one of the two components remains unbroken — providing defense-in-depth during the migration period.
